did: Mochi and Tin Bird can now play roles. Each has five: everyday, analyst, coach, fan and presenter. A role's look is a colour theme, something worn (a tie, a bow tie, a cap, a whistle or a scarf) and sometimes a prop held at its side (a clipboard, a microphone or a pennant). Some feelings now change a character's colour over its role's colours: angry flushes and throbs, anxious turns pale, happy glows, ceremonious gilds and hungry turns wan. Hungry is a new feeling for both characters. A scene's beat can name the role, and the Cast wing in the phone app has role chips on both screens, so every look can be seen in every role. A contact sheet shows each character in each role across seven feelings.

calls.title: What roles there are, and what each wears
options: Five roles per character, composed from closed themes, costume pieces and props
Themes and costumes chosen separately on each beat, with no role between them
calls.why: The owner said a role has a look (colours, a tie, a tool), and composing roles from small closed sets lets a new role be one line of data.

calls.title: How a feeling's colour meets a role's colours
options: A tint mixed over the role's colours, eased in
A colour theme per feeling, replacing the role's colours
Tint only the cheeks and eyes
calls.why: It keeps role and feeling separate choices that both stay readable, so an angry analyst is a flushed slate and an angry fan a flushed red.
calls.undo: Set a feeling's entry in EMOTION_TINTS to null, or pass no tint in host.ts (C1541).

calls.title: Hungry as a feeling
options: Add hungry for both characters, with a wan colour
Show colour by feeling only on the feelings that existed
calls.why: The owner's own example of colour by feeling was hunger; Mochi got a hungry pose and Tin Bird borrows its taciturn motion for now.
calls.undo: Remove hungry from SHARED_EMOTIONS and its drawings, tint and words (C1542).

calls.title: Tinted feelings change how existing scenes draw
options: Keep the design name cast-v1, since no video with the host is published yet
Start a new design, cast-v2, for the tint
calls.why: Nothing published uses the host yet, and the loop stories redrew cast-v1 the same way.
calls.undo: Add cast-v2 to HOST_DESIGNS in packages/ui/burn-ins and gate the tint on it (C1544).

left: When a loop raises Mochi's right arm, a prop's little hand still shows at its side, so that side has two hands; filed on #3564.
A feeling's colour fades in again from nothing whenever its loop restarts, including at each seam of the Cast wing's 6.8 second preview; blending across beats is #3564's.
Tin Bird's hungry borrows its taciturn motion; a rig pass could give it a pose of its own.
